name: @zapwebp/sdk
description: Official JavaScript and TypeScript client SDK for Zapwebp with agentic runtime discovery, typed tool exports, and self-correcting error envelopes.

functions.name: convert
functions.signature: convert(opts: ConvertOptions | ImageInput, options?: ConvertOptions): Promise<ConvertResult>
functions.description: Convert an image to WebP, AVIF, PNG, or JPEG. Preserves transparency and strips metadata by default. Returns nextAction hint.

input.description: Buffer, Uint8Array, Blob, URL string, or file path

functions.name: convertBatch
functions.description: Convert multiple images concurrently with shared or per-item target formats.
functions.example: const batch = await zap.convertBatch({ inputs: ['a.png', 'b.svg'], to: 'webp' });

functions.name: convertUrl
functions.signature: convertUrl(opts: { url: string, to?: string, quality?: number }): Promise<ConvertResult>
functions.description: Fetch a remote image URL securely with private subnet SSRF guard and convert it in memory.
functions.example: const res = await zap.convertUrl({ url: 'https://example.com/logo.png', to: 'webp' });

functions.name: inspect
functions.description: Inspect image container chunks, format, dimensions, transparency, and receive recommended targets with nextAction hint.
functions.example:
const info = await zap.inspect('banner.png');
console.log(info.format, info.hasAlpha, info.nextAction);

functions.name: inspectUrl
functions.description: Inspect a remote image without persisting it to disk.

functions.name: verifyClean
functions.description: Verify whether an image has zero residual EXIF, XMP, IPTC, or C2PA metadata chunks.
functions.example:
const check = await zap.verifyClean({ input: outputBytes });
if (!check.clean) console.warn('Metadata found:', check.metadataChunks);

functions.name: verifyAlpha
functions.description: Directly inspect image pixel alpha channels to confirm transparency preservation.

functions.name: suggestConversion
functions.signature: suggestConversion(opts: { input: ImageInput, useCase?: string }): Promise<SuggestResult>
functions.description: AI agent helper: analyzes image properties and useCase to recommend format, quality, and nextAction conversion call.
functions.example: const suggestion = await zap.suggestConversion({ input: 'hero.png', useCase: 'hero' });

functions.name: auditCommand
functions.description: Analyze an ImageMagick, ffmpeg, or cwebp command for alpha loss bugs and return a safe Zapwebp equivalent.
functions.example: const audit = await zap.auditCommand({ command: 'convert logo.svg logo.jpg' });

functions.name: listTools
functions.description: Discover all available Zapwebp tool schemas at runtime for dynamic agent execution menus.

functions.name: getAgentManifest
functions.description: Retrieve the full runtime agent discovery manifest.

functions.name: getUsage
functions.description: Inspect offline operations count and memory usage, or remote API quota statistics.

E_ALPHA_NOT_REPRESENTABLE.fix: Pass background: '#ffffff' to flatten, or choose webp/png/avif.

E_UNSAFE_SVG.message: SVG contains scripts, inline event handlers, or external entities.
E_UNSAFE_SVG.fix: Remove active elements or pass allowUnsafe: true in isolated environments.

E_TOO_LARGE.message: Input exceeds size boundaries or resolution limit.
E_TOO_LARGE.fix: Compress the file or raise maxInputBytes in policy.
